newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra surges in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Astra surges in early trade.

text.p: Shares in Indonesia's largest automobile manufacturer Astra International surged in early trade on reports that a group linked to President Suharto could make a general offer, brokers said.
Astra rose 150 rupiah, or 3.8 percent, to 4,100 rupiah in the first ten minutes of trade on the Jakarta Stock Exchange.
"The news that an Astra shareholder says 4,200 rupiah per share is a good price has led to active buying on the stock," said a broker from a Singapore-based firm.
Bisnis Indonesia newspaper quoted businessman Sofjan Wanandi, whose Gemala Group owns about a two percent stake in Astra, as saying 4,200 rupiah per share was a fair price.
His comments came as other newspapers said the Nusamba Group, in which three foundations headed by Suharto own an 80 percent stake, could make a general offer for Astra shares.
The broker said there was potential for more gains as Astra's foreign shares closed at 4,350 rupiah on Friday.
Brokers said the rise was mostly on buying by local investors.
